items.text: Fixed collision issues with the large rig monument blocker, preventing players from getting stuck.
Added missing vent cages to oil rigs, restoring proper ventilation.
Introduced new large and small oil rig variants (S2P), expanding oil rig locations.
Prevented trees from spawning inside water pipe structures, reducing unwanted obstructions.
Fixed a bug where sleepers in safe zones were not killed after a server restart.
Corrected missing name token for HQM collectables, ensuring they display properly in inventories.
Fixed frog behavior issues, restoring expected frog movement and interactions.
Improved critter state handling, making animal interest reactions more reliable.
Improved deployment of carvable pumpkins, fixing placement glitches.
Beach areas can now be connected to water pipe networks, allowing pipe placement on the shoreline.
Electrical circuits now process mid‑tick changes immediately, fixing delayed reactions.

2026-08-31.summary:
### Monuments & World
- Fixed collision issues with the large rig monument blocker, preventing players from getting stuck.
- Added missing vent cages to oil rigs, restoring proper ventilation.
- Introduced new large and small oil rig variants (S2P), expanding oil rig locations.
- Prevented trees from spawning inside water pipe structures, reducing unwanted obstructions.

### Safety & Raids
- Fixed a bug where sleepers in safe zones were not killed after a server restart.

### Collectables & UI
- Corrected missing name token for HQM collectables, ensuring they display properly in inventories.

### Animals & NPCs
- Fixed frog behavior issues, restoring expected frog movement and interactions.
- Improved critter state handling, making animal interest reactions more reliable.

### Deployables
- Improved deployment of carvable pumpkins, fixing placement glitches.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Beach areas can now be connected to water pipe networks, allowing pipe placement on the shoreline.
- Electrical circuits now process mid‑tick changes immediately, fixing delayed reactions.

items.text: Heavy plate helmets now muffle player voice more strongly (volume reduction lowered from 2400 to 1800).
Reduced pipe hole mesh size and adjusted anchor setup to eliminate terrain gaps, preventing unintended openings in structures.

2026-08-30.summary:
### Audio & Communication
- Heavy plate helmets now muffle player voice more strongly (volume reduction lowered from 2400 to 1800).

### Gameplay & Balance

items.text: Explosive ammo now damages monument blockers as intended.
Crates and barrels on both oil rigs now respawn correctly after being looted.
Siege tower doors function properly and NPCs no longer get stuck when doors slam on them.
Fixed a bug where deployable structures could display random skins, ensuring they keep their intended appearance.
